name: VolunteerRelatedProjects - One Other Project
description: The state the site reaches first. The projects collection holds one entry today, so the moment a second is posted every detail page has exactly one other project to offer - this is what the section looks like before there is enough to fill a row. Two things it checks that the three-card capture cannot: the heading still reads naturally in the singular, which is why You may also be interested in was chosen over a phrasing that claims a count, and a lone card holds one-third width at the left of the grid rather than stretching across it.
